issue_snapshot.title: Follow-ups from #37: 4 from the review
issue_snapshot.body:
What the review and QA of PR #44 (for #37) found and did not fix there — filed as it merged, one ticket for the lot.

## From the review

Non-blocking findings the reviewer approved despite: a statement about severity, not a judgement that they are wrong.

### A leave blocked by a non-zero balance names the blocker but offers no settle-up link, while the identical refusal on remove does.

> A leave blocked by a non-zero balance names the blocker but offers no settle-up link, while the identical refusal on remove does.
> 
> `components/groups-panels.tsx`
> 
> Evidence: leaveGroup returns the same NonZeroBalanceError sentence as removeMember (lib/groups/actions.ts:405 vs :355), but MembersPanel renders only `<StateMessage state={leaveState} />` (components/groups-panels.tsx:707) with no isBalanceBlockedRefusal check, while RemoveMemberForm checks it (:468) and renders the Settle up link to /groups/<id>#debts-heading (:491; anchor exists at app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:320). Repro: carry a balance, press Leave group and confirm: the refusal names the blocker with no way onward.
> 
> Fix: Mirror the remove path beside leaveState: const leaveBlocked = isBalanceBlockedRefusal(leaveState.message) and render the same Settle up link when true.

### An archived solo-owner group shows invite-sharing empty-state copy for a link that cannot work.

> An archived solo-owner group shows invite-sharing empty-state copy for a link that cannot work.
> 
> `app/groups/[id]/members/page.tsx`
> 
> Evidence: SoloOwnerAction returns null when group.archived (app/groups/[id]/members/page.tsx:234), so the EmptyState renders with no action, yet its body (:191) still says 'Share the invite link and the rest can join — or add somebody by name below if they have not signed up'. Archived groups refuse join/rotate/disable writes (ARCHIVED_STATE in lib/groups/actions.ts) and the same screen says seats cannot be added (:200), so both suggested actions fail and the read-only wording AC-2 requires is not what the empty state says.
> 
> Fix: When group.archived, give the solo-owner EmptyState read-only copy instead of the invite-sharing sentence (or suppress the EmptyState for archived groups, since the seats note already covers it).

### A ?saved=1 success notice from an earlier save stays on screen beside a later inline refusal: the page renders the notice from searchParams at server render, and the island refusal navigates nowhere, so 'Profile saved.' and fresh field errors show at once.

> A ?saved=1 success notice from an earlier save stays on screen beside a later inline refusal: the page renders the notice from searchParams at server render, and the island refusal navigates nowhere, so 'Profile saved.' and fresh field errors show at once.
> 
> `app/profile/page.tsx:39`
> 
> Evidence: git show pr44:app/profile/page.tsx lines 39-44: notice derives from searchParams (?saved=1/?error=invalid) and renders in the role=status slot; git show pr44:components/profile-form.tsx:38: refusal returns inline via useActionState with no navigation, so the param (and its notice) survives the refusal render. On main (git show main:lib/auth/actions.ts) a refusal redirected to /profile?error=invalid, which replaced the param — this staleness is new with the inline transport.
> 
> Fix: Pass the saved/error flags into ProfileForm (or lift the notice into the island) and suppress the query-param notice once the action state holds a refusal (state.status === 'error'), so the page never claims 'Profile saved.' beside fresh field errors.

### An archived group with only its owner shows a 'Share the invite link' empty state with no action: the solo-owner EmptyState ignores group.archived, and SoloOwnerAction returns null for archived groups, leaving share-the-link copy directly above the archived read-only note.

> An archived group with only its owner shows a 'Share the invite link' empty state with no action: the solo-owner EmptyState ignores group.archived, and SoloOwnerAction returns null for archived groups, leaving share-the-link copy directly above the archived read-only note.
> 
> `app/groups/[id]/members/page.tsx:187`
> 
> Evidence: git show pr44:app/groups/[id]/members/page.tsx:109: soloOwner is isOwner && members.length === 1 with no archived condition; lines 187-193 render the EmptyState ('Share the invite link and the rest can join') unconditionally on it; SoloOwnerAction (lines 227-234) returns null when group.archived, so the archived solo group gets the sharing copy, no action, then the line-196 'archived, so seats cannot be added' note.
> 
> Fix: Render the solo-owner EmptyState only when !group.archived, or give archived solo groups their own sentence that points at the read-only note instead of the invite link.

---

**Check each one still reproduces before planning it.** They were written against the PR as it stood, and a later round can have fixed one. Some may not hold up: say so and drop them rather than implementing something that was never wrong. Split this if they turn out to be unrelated.

Depends on #37.
